examples.en: A brass plate beside the door said 'Dr Alan Tate'.
examples.zh: 门旁的铜牌上写着“艾伦•泰特医生”。

examples.en: Several of his paintings hang in the Tate Gallery.
examples.zh: 他的几幅油画挂在塔特美术馆。

examples.en: But a cleaner who works in the Tate Gallery in London isn't able to tell the difference.
examples.zh: 但在伦敦泰特美术馆工作的一名清洁工却分辨不出两者的区别。
